description: Update an existing On-Call Policy in OneUptime. Only include the fields you want to change - unspecified fields will remain unchanged. Use get_on_call_policy afterwards to see the updated record.

acknowledgementTimeoutInMinutes.description: Page again when something this policy paged about is acknowledged but not resolved within this many minutes (5 to 1440). Empty: never.

description.description: Friendly description that will help you remember.
description.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the On-Call Policy to update. Required. Use list_on_call_duty_policies to find IDs.

isArchived.description: Archived on-call policies are hidden from the On-Call Policies list and page no one: incidents and alerts that use them skip them. Unarchiving puts them back in service.

labels.description: Relation to Labels Array where this object is categorized in.

name.description: Any friendly name of this object.

repeatPolicyIfNoOneAcknowledges.description: Repeat the policy if no one acknowledges the alert.

repeatPolicyIfNoOneAcknowledgesNoOfTimes.description: Repeat the policy X number of times if no one acknowledges the alert.

name: update_on_call_policy
title: Update On-Call Policy
